---
title: AI chat credit settlement
description: How chat replies are charged exactly once after streaming, how a failed charge is recorded, and the bounded Cron Control job that settles it.
updatedAt: "2026-11-21"
audience: developers
---

## Decision

Every assistant chat message is charged **at most once**, and a charge that
fails after the reply was served is **recorded, not dropped**.

- Scope: the shared chat route (`packages/ai/src/chat/google/route.ts`) used by
  Mira and AI chat on web and mobile. Fixed-cost tool reservations and
  AI Studio runs settle through their own reservation RPCs.
- Default: the reply is always delivered and saved first; credits settle from
  the stream's `onFinish`/`onAbort`, after the response has returned.
- Exception: a charge with no workspace (`wsId`) cannot be settled and is
  only logged.

## Exactly once

`public.deduct_ai_credits` returns the earlier deduction when one already
exists for `p_chat_message_id`, instead of charging again. The wallet row lock
serializes concurrent settlements of one message; settlements that resolve
different wallets meet at the unique partial index
`ai_credit_transactions_one_chat_message_deduction`, and the loser returns the
winner's row. The index (migration `20261121184400`, built `CONCURRENTLY` so
ledger writes continue) covers rows from 2026-11-21 00:00Z on, so older rows
cannot block it. Before applying it, confirm no message has two deductions in
that window:

```sql
select chat_message_id, count(*)
from public.ai_credit_transactions
where transaction_type = 'deduction' and chat_message_id is not null
  and created_at >= timestamptz '2026-11-21 00:00:00+00'
group by chat_message_id having count(*) > 1;
```

Settlement runs outside the request scope (Next `after()`, Cloudflare
`waitUntil`). Its admin clients use `createAdminClient({ noCookie: true })`,
because the default admin client reads request cookies and throws there.

## Unbilled charges

When the post-stream deduction throws or returns `success: false`,
`recordUnbilledAiCharge` (`packages/ai/src/credits/check-credits.ts`) calls
`public.record_unbilled_ai_charge`, which inserts one row per message into
`private.ai_credit_unbilled_charges` (first record wins). The log line
`Failed to deduct AI credits after assistant response.` or
`AI credit deduction returned unsuccessful result.` carries the error class,
message and `recordedUnbilled`.

The table has row level security, no policies and no grants; only the
service-role `SECURITY DEFINER` functions read or write it. It has no foreign
key to the message or the user, so deleting either leaves the record to end
`abandoned` and never bills a deleted user's charge to the workspace wallet.

## Retry job

Cron Control job `ai-credit-unbilled-settlement` (`*/15 * * * *`, enabled in
`apps/cron-control/cloudflare.config.ts`) calls
`private.settle_unbilled_ai_charges(p_limit)` once per slot:

- At most 100 pending rows per call, oldest first, `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`.
- Each row is charged through `deduct_ai_credits`, so a replay never charges
  twice. Success marks it `settled`.
- A failure increments `attempts` and keeps `last_error`; the fifth failure
  marks it `abandoned`, a terminal audit record of uncharged usage. A
  timeout, deadlock or serialization failure aborts the run without spending
  an attempt.
- No in-slot retry. Five failed or unknown slots stop the job durably in the
  Cron Control ledger.

## Cost bounds

| Bound | Per slot (96 a day) |
| --- | --- |
| Database requests | 1 |
| Rows processed | At most 100, each at most 5 times in its lifetime |
| Processor time | 30 seconds |

## Stop

- Fastest: `POST /control/jobs/ai-credit-unbilled-settlement/stop` (operator
  token).
- Database, without a deploy:
  `revoke execute on function private.settle_unbilled_ai_charges(integer) from service_role;`
- Config: remove the id from `CRON_CONTROL_ENABLED_JOBS`.
- `apps/database/rollbacks/20261121184500_ai_chat_credit_exactly_once.rollback.sql`
  restores the previous wrapper and drops the store; read non-settled rows
  first.

## Inspect

```sql
select status, count(*), max(attempts), min(created_at)
from private.ai_credit_unbilled_charges group by status;
```

## Regression evidence

- `apps/database/supabase/tests/ai-chat-credit-exactly-once.sql`: one charge per
  message across repeated settlement, the index rejecting a second row, first
  record wins, settlement of pending rows without re-charging an already
  charged message, abandonment after five attempts, the zero limit, grants and
  pinned search paths.
- `packages/ai/src/chat/google/stream-finish-persistence.test.ts`: a thrown or
  unsuccessful deduction keeps the reply and records it unbilled; a deducted
  charge is not recorded.
- `packages/ai/src/credits/check-credits-cache.test.ts`: settlement and
  recording use the cookie-free admin client and the ledger's pricing.
- `apps/cron-control/src/ai-credit-unbilled-settlement.test.ts`: registration,
  default off, one bounded call per slot, durable stop, failure stop and
  invalid summaries.
